title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
lede: On stage at DealBook, Sam Altman and Greg Brockman said they had privately reached out to Jensen Huang after his resignation, with Altman crediting Huang's early bet on OpenAI.

points: Altman described the relationship as two big bets: Nvidia on OpenAI, and OpenAI on Nvidia.
Nvidia invested $30 billion in OpenAI earlier this year and designs the chips its models run on.
Brockman said he and his wife contacted Huang's family as friends, and called the company Huang built one made to last.
Nearly 200,000 people, Elon Musk among them, signed a petition asking Nvidia to reinstate Huang; Nvidia said it will not, though he offered to return.
Altman declined to guess at Huang's future, saying the world has heard enough speculation already.

sections.text: OpenAI depends on Nvidia for both chips and capital, so its leaders saying they intend to keep partnering is a signal of continuity for anyone building on OpenAI's models.
